fans.none: No controllable fans found. Is the it87 module loaded?
fans.curve.hint.fork: Drag a point to make a Custom profile from %1. Double-click adds, right-click removes.
fans.curve.hint: Drag points to edit. Double-click adds a point, right-click removes one.
fans.calibrate.tip: Measures each fan's stop, start and RPM response (~2 min) so curves are quiet and RPM-accurate
fans.retest.tip: Check whether this fan follows PWM now (~15 s; the fan briefly stops if it does). If it responds it is calibrated (~2 min) and put on its curve.
fans.bios.tip: Let the motherboard's own fan curve run the fans; off takes control back with the selected profile
